summary_en: This Phase II study tests zanzalintinib plus an investigator-chosen bone-strengthening agent in people with metastatic clear cell renal cell carcinoma that has spread to bone. Zanzalintinib is taken by mouth once a day in 28-day cycles and continued until study stop criteria are met, and the bone-strengthening agent is given intravenously. The record does not state the main outcome measure; this is a Phase II study.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase II evalúa zanzalintinib junto con un agente fortalecedor de huesos elegido por el investigador, en personas con carcinoma de células renales de células claras metastásico que se ha diseminado a los huesos. El zanzalintinib se toma por vía oral una vez al día en ciclos de 28 días y se continúa hasta cumplir los criterios de suspensión del estudio, mientras que el agente fortalecedor de huesos se administra por vía intravenosa. El registro no indica la medida de resultado principal; se trata de un estudio de fase II.
who_for: Unresectable advanced or metastatic kidney cancer with a mainly clear cell type
At least three bone metastases seen on bone scan, with one not planned for radiation
1 to 3 prior lines of therapy, including immune-based therapy in the metastatic or adjuvant setting
ECOG performance status of 2 or less
Adequate blood, liver and kidney function within 14 days before first study treatment
not_for: Prior treatment with zanzalintinib for kidney cancer
Small molecule kinase inhibitor or VEGF-targeted therapy within 2 weeks before first dose
Known brain metastases or cranial epidural disease not adequately treated and stable
Certain anticoagulants or platelet inhibitors, or recent significant bleeding
